The largest loan in the latest Benefit Street Partners securitized loan offering is backed by the newly built 226-unit Surfhouse apartments in Asbury Park, New Jersey. (CoStar)

Benefit Street Partners has closed a roughly $1.1 billion commercial real estate collateralized loan obligation, extending a busy year for the lender as it puts substantial capital to work in short-term bridge loans that provide financing until borrowers obtain longer-term debt.

This news story is available exclusively to CoStar subscribers.
